renderDetails.messageTitle: Message from BMW M5 Image Generator (image-generator)

content:
Image generation failed due to a quota/capacity error (HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: "You have exhausted your capacity on this model. Your quota will reset after 4s."). Per instructions, I did not retry the quota/capacity error.

Additional notes on what could not be done:
- No image file was generated.
- The requested 16:10 aspect ratio is not supported by `generate_image` (closest supported widescreen option `16:9` was used in the attempt).
- Generated images are saved directly to the artifact directory rather than `C:\Users\User\OneDrive\Desktop\CarVault project\images\cars\bmw-m5.png`.
